title: Polynomial Learning of Positive ReLU Networks under Gaussian Inputs
abstract: arXiv:2610.25116v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study positive, bias-free, one-hidden-layer ReLU networks under standard Gaussian inputs. We obtain algorithms with polynomial sample and real-arithmetic complexity, without separation or conditioning assumptions on the hidden directions. When the conditional label mean is a width-$k$ network with total output weight at most one, the learner achieves squared prediction error $\varepsilon$ with output width at most $k+\min\{k,d\}$ and complexity linear in one plus the residual second moment. For arbitrary labels with bounded second moment, we obtain a positive ReLU network of width $O(k\log(2/\varepsilon))$. Its risk is bounded by the irreducible noise variance plus $Ck^3\log^{9/2}(2k/\varepsilon)$ times the squared distance of the conditional mean to the target class, plus $\varepsilon$. translated_title: 高斯输入下正ReLU网络的多项式学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了标准高斯输入下正的、无偏置的单隐层ReLU网络。我们获得了具有多项式样本复杂度与实数算术复杂度的算法，且无需对隐藏方向施加分离或条件化假设。当条件标签均值是一个总输出权重不超过1、宽度为 $k$ 的网络时，学习器能够以不超过 $k+\min\{k,d\}$ 的输出宽度实现 $\varepsilon$ 的平方预测误差，其复杂度与1加上残差二阶矩成线性关系。对于二阶矩有界的任意标签，我们构造出宽度为 $O(k\log(2/\varepsilon))$ 的正ReLU网络，其风险由不可约噪声方差、加上 $Ck^3\log^{9/2}(2k/\varepsilon)$ 乘以条件均值到目标类距离的平方、再加上 $\varepsilon$ 所界定。证明结合了隐式Hermite矩、正交张量列车压缩，以及一个方向解码器，该解码器以一定概率返回直接的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文在不对隐藏方向施加任何分离或条件化假设的前提下，首次为标准高斯输入下正ReLU网络的学习给出了样本与实数算术复杂度均为多项式的算法，并提供了误差与风险的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper gives polynomial sample- and real-arithmetic-complexity algorithms for learning positive ReLU networks under standard Gaussian inputs, without any separation or conditioning assumptions on hidden directions, together with provable error and risk guarantees.
